title.zh: DNS 污染与 DNS 泄漏深度防护教程：Fake-IP 原理、DoH / DoT 加密与防泄漏全流程
title.en: DNS Pollution & DNS Leak Prevention: Fake-IP Mechanisms, Encrypted DoH/DoT & Full Protection

cluster.zh: TUN 虚拟网卡深度分流

description.zh: 深度解析出海过程中的两大核心安全隐患：DNS 污染与 DNS 泄漏。详解 Fake-IP 模式工作原理、DoH/DoT 加密查询配置、防 ISP 域名窥探及使用 dnsleaktest 验证真实防护效果实战。
description.en: In-depth guide to combating DNS pollution and DNS leaks during international browsing. Master Fake-IP architecture, encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH), preventing ISP traffic surveillance, and verifying protection with dnsleaktest.
